# Core

The thread list, tabs, chat, composer, session control and Settings every other pack builds on.

Pack id `core`, always on: every other pack builds on it. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/thread-sidebar`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-sidebar/README.md) — Replace the DSH sidebar with project-scoped thread groups and customizable navigation.
2. [`@dshfiles/main-tabs`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/main-tabs/README.md) — Browser-like tabs above the main view for threads and global panels: pin, reorder, preview, shortcuts, per-project persistence.
3. [`@dshfiles/chat`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/chat/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Chat plugin that mounts only the transcript rows near the viewport.
4. [`@dshfiles/rich-composer`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/rich-composer/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Conversation plugin with structured session-reference paste.
5. [`@dshfiles/session-controller`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/session-controller/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Session controller that sends the browser only what it renders.
6. [`@dshfiles/settings-shell`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/settings-shell/README.md) — VS Code-style DSH Settings shell with plugin settings, search, and notices for new DSH releases.

## Prerequisites

1. An AI account is configured.
2. A project is added.

## Key settings

1. **Restart by itself when idle to apply updates**: Settings entry `thread-sidebar`, field `autoRestartWhenIdle`.

## Enable it

Core is always on: Getting started offers no Enable or Disable for it, `onboarding_pack_apply` never disables it, and `dshx init` composes it into every profile.

To compose a new profile with Core only: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs core`.

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
